entities.name: Q89AL6 OMP decarboxylase
observations: Exact 236-aa query sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q89AL6 from Buchnera aphidicola strain Bp; annotated as orotidine 5'-phosphate decarboxylase, EC 4.1.1.23.
Catalyzes decarboxylation of orotidine 5'-monophosphate (OMP) to uridine 5'-monophosphate (UMP) in de novo pyrimidine/UMP biosynthesis.

entities.name: RHEA:11596
observations: Reaction: orotidine 5'-phosphate + H(+) = UMP + CO2; EC 4.1.1.23, orotidine 5'-phosphate decarboxylation.
